name: Ben Reilly
distinction: A clone of Peter Parker, created by the Jackal. He is not a separate spider bite and not a symbiote.
summary: Ben Reilly is a clone of Peter Parker. He later fights as the Scarlet Spider and, for a time, as Spider-Man. His history is tied to Miles Warren’s cloning experiments.
firstAppearance: As a clone, The Amazing Spider-Man #149 (1975). The Scarlet Spider identity is a 1990s development in the Clone Saga.
creators: Gerry Conway and Ross Andru introduced the clone.
